lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice kan plus infinitive for ability and simple help in conversation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A learner-friendly office chat about Swedish practice.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Saying what you can do and asking someone to adjust their speech.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk during fika about speaking and understanding Swedish, including asking someone to speak slowly or repeat.

main_focus.name: kan plus infinitive
main_focus.description: Use kan before an infinitive to express ability or a simple request.
model_examples: Anna kan läsa men inte förstå allt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use kan plus infinitive naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical learner phrases that help keep a Swedish conversation going.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about Swedish practice or notices the other using Swedish.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss what they can understand, say, read, or write, with one clarification request.
dialogue_shape.ending: They encourage continuing in simple Swedish and return to fika.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat kan in statements and questions

focus: what one speaker can do in Swedish
what one speaker does not understand

sentence_focus: one sentence about reading or writing Swedish
